---
title: "Explorer la NAF"
page-layout: full
include-after-body: "../includes/explorer-scripts.html"
---

::: {.naf-page}

```{=html}
<div class="naf-app" id="naf-app" data-depth="0" data-view="browse">

  <div class="naf-toolbar">
    <form class="naf-searchbox" id="naf-searchbox" role="search" autocomplete="off">
      <label class="naf-visually-hidden" for="naf-q">Rechercher un code ou une activité</label>
      <svg class="naf-search-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
        <circle cx="9" cy="9" r="6"></circle>
        <line x1="13.5" y1="13.5" x2="18" y2="18"></line>
      </svg>
      <input id="naf-q" type="search" class="naf-search-input"
             placeholder="30.32Y, aéronautique, logiciel…"
             aria-describedby="naf-search-help">
      <button type="button" class="naf-search-clear" id="naf-search-clear"
              aria-label="Effacer la recherche" hidden>&times;</button>
    </form>

    <div class="naf-versions" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Version de la nomenclature">
      <button type="button" class="naf-version" role="radio" aria-checked="true"
              data-version="2025">NAF 2025</button>
      <button type="button" class="naf-version" role="radio" aria-checked="false"
              data-version="2008">NAF 2008</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <p id="naf-search-help" class="naf-visually-hidden">
    La recherche accepte un code ou un libellé, sans tenir compte des accents ni de la casse.
  </p>

  <p class="naf-counts" id="naf-counts" role="status" aria-live="polite">Chargement de la nomenclature…</p>

  <section class="naf-results" id="naf-results" aria-label="Résultats de recherche" hidden></section>

  <div class="naf-browser" id="naf-browser">
    <div class="naf-mobilebar" id="naf-mobilebar"></div>
    <nav class="naf-crumbs" id="naf-crumbs" aria-label="Chemin dans la nomenclature"></nav>
    <div class="naf-columns" id="naf-columns"></div>
  </div>

  <section class="naf-sheet" id="naf-sheet" aria-label="Fiche de l'activité" hidden></section>

  <p class="naf-error" id="naf-error" role="alert" hidden></p>
</div>
```

:::
